DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご来院ですね。今日は歯のどんなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit, isn't it? What trouble are you having with your teeth today?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、右下の詰め物が取れました。取れたものを袋に入れて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日右下の詰め物が取れたことと持参したことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday, a filling in my lower right teeth came out. I put it in a bag and brought it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your lower right filling came out yesterday and that you brought it with you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見せてください。ありがとうございます。取れてから痛みや腫れはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me see it. Thank you. Have you had any pain or swelling since it came out?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何もしなければ痛くないですが、冷たい水を飲むとしみます。腫れは感じません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷水でしみるが安静時の痛みと自覚する腫れはないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It doesn't hurt when I leave it alone, but cold water makes it sensitive. I haven't noticed any swelling.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that cold water causes sensitivity, but you have no pain at rest and have not noticed any swelling. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず歯の状態を確認します。歯ぐきにも触れますので、痛かったら左手を上げてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, I'll check the condition of the tooth. I'll also touch your gums, so please raise your left hand if it hurts.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緊張しているので、口の中を見る前に何をするか一言教えてもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 緊張しているため診察前に動作を説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm nervous, so it would help if you briefly told me what you are going to do before looking inside my mouth.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are nervous and ask for an explanation of what will be done before the examination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: わかりました。小さな鏡で見てから、必要な検査と治療の進め方をご説明します。途中でも気になることはおっしゃってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. I'll look with a small mirror first, then explain the necessary tests and how we will proceed with treatment. Please tell me if anything concerns you during the examination, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は仕事があるので、十二時までに出たいです。時間のかかる治療は別の日にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事のため十二時に出る必要を伝え長い治療の別日実施を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have work today, so I'd like to leave by twelve. Could any time-consuming treatment be done on another day?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you need to leave at twelve for work, and ask about scheduling lengthy treatment on another day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時間のご希望はわかりました。今日はまず診察を進め、治療が必要な場合は緊急性と所要時間をご説明して、予定をご相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I understand your time preference. Today, we'll start with the examination. If treatment is necessary, I'll explain how urgent it is and how long it will take, and we'll discuss the schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それでお願いします。時間がかかる場合は、説明を聞いてから次回の治療日を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時間がかかる場合は説明後に次回の治療日を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. If it will take a long time, I'd like to hear the explanation first and then discuss a date for treatment at my next visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that if treatment will take a long time, you would like to hear the explanation before discussing a date for the next treatment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、先ほどご説明した治療の続きは次回にしましょう。受付でご希望の日をお伝えください。今日はお疲れさまでした。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll continue the treatment I explained earlier at your next visit. Please tell reception your preferred date. Thank you for coming today. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 試着された上着はいかがでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: How was the jacket you tried on?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 肩はちょうどいいのですが、袖が指まで隠れます。一つ小さいサイズを試せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 肩は合うが袖が指まで隠れるため一つ小さいサイズの試着を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shoulders fit just right, but the sleeves cover my fingers. Could I try one size smaller?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the shoulders fit but the sleeves cover your fingers, and ask to try one size smaller. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちします。小さい方は身幅も細くなるので、腕を前に出して比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll bring one. The smaller size will also be narrower through the body, so try stretching your arms forward to compare them.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい方だと背中が突っ張ります。元のサイズの袖を直す方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さいサイズで背中が突っ張るため元のサイズの袖直しを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The smaller one feels tight across my back. Is there any way to alter the sleeves on the original size?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the smaller size pulls across your back, and ask about altering the sleeves on the original size. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袖口の構造によっては難しいため、私から可能とはお約束できません。直しの担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may be difficult depending on how the cuffs are constructed, so I can't promise that it can be done. I'll check with the alterations specialist.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今すぐ決めなくて大丈夫です。確認中に、袖が短めの別の上着も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直しの確認中に袖が短めの別型を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's no need to decide right away. While you're checking, I'd also like to look at another jacket with shorter sleeves.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that while the alterations are being checked, you would like to see another style with shorter sleeves. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは別の形です。袖の長さだけでなく、腕を上げたときの動きやすさも試してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is a different style. Please check not only the sleeve length, but also how easily you can move when you raise your arms.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらなら手首が出ますし、腕も動かせます。この色以外に紺はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別型の動きやすさを伝え紺色の在庫を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one leaves my wrists showing, and I can move my arms. Besides this color, do you have it in navy?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe how easy the other style is to move in, and ask whether it is available in navy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紺を一着お持ちしました。試着できますので、色と着心地を確認してからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've brought one in navy. You can try it on, so please check the color and how it feels before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紺も同じように動きやすかったです。袖直しの相談はやめて、こちらを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紺の着心地を確認したうえで袖直しをやめ別型の購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The navy one was just as easy to move in. I'll drop the sleeve alteration request and buy this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking how the navy jacket feels, decide to buy the other style instead of having the sleeves altered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。最初の上着はこちらでお戻しします。ご購入ありがとうございます。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll put the first jacket back for you. Thank you for your purchase. Please visit us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約されたお車をご用意しました。出発前に車体を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The car you reserved is ready. Let's check the bodywork together before you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 助手席のドアの下に細い傷があります。出発前からあった傷として記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 助手席ドア下の傷を出発前の傷として記録するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a thin scratch below the front passenger door. Please record it as damage that was there before I left.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the scratch below the front passenger door to be recorded as pre-existing damage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認表に記入しました。ほかに気になる箇所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've entered it on the inspection sheet. Are there any other areas you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左の後輪が少し低く見えます。空気圧を確認してから出発したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左後輪が低く見えるため出発前の空気圧確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The left rear tire looks a little low. I'd like to have the pressure checked before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the left rear tire looks low and ask to have its pressure checked before departure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 点検担当が測定しますので、確認が終わるまでお待ちください。その間に返却方法でご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Our inspection staff will measure it, so please wait until the check is finished. In the meantime, do you have any questions about returning the car?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返す前の給油について聞きたいです。この車は何の燃料を入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返却前の給油に使う燃料の種類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to ask about refueling before returning it. What kind of fuel does this car take?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what type of fuel to use when refueling before returning the car. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この車はレギュラーガソリンです。給油口の表示も一緒に確認しましょう。給油後のレシートは返却時にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This car takes regular gasoline. Let's also check the label by the fuel filler together. Please show us your refueling receipt when you return the car.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レギュラーですね。返却直前に給油して、レシートを持ってくればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レギュラーを返却直前に給油しレシートを持参する手順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Regular gasoline, right? Should I fill it just before returning it and bring the receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the procedure of filling with regular gasoline just before returning the car and bringing the receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。タイヤの点検も終わり、空気圧を調整しました。確認表の傷の記録をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The tire inspection is also finished, and we've adjusted the pressure. Please check the scratch recorded on the inspection sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 傷の記録を確認しました。給油のレシートも保管します。車の点検が終わったので出発します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 傷の記録を確認しレシート保管と点検後の出発を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the scratch record. I'll keep the refueling receipt, too. Now that the car inspection is finished, I'll set off.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the recorded scratch and say that you will keep the receipt and leave now that the inspection is finished. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 鍵をお渡しします。お気をつけて運転してください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the keys. Please drive safely. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お預かりしている御朱印帳の受け取りですか。番号札をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect the goshuin stamp book you left with us? May I have your numbered ticket, please?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、参拝を終えて戻りました。番号札は十二番です。まだ時間がかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝を終えたことと札が十二番であることを伝え待ち時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I've finished praying and come back. My ticket is number twelve. Will it take much longer?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have finished praying and your ticket is number twelve, and ask about the remaining wait. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十二番は書いている途中です。仕上がったらこの窓口で番号をお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We're still writing number twelve. We'll call your number at this counter when it's ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 呼ばれるまで、向こうの日陰で待っても番号が聞こえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日陰で待っても呼び出しが聞こえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I wait in the shade over there until I'm called, will I still be able to hear my number?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can hear your number being called if you wait in the shade. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そちらまでは声が届きにくいので、この窓口が見える長椅子をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Our voices don't carry very well that far, so please use the bench where you can see this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 長椅子で待ちます。同行者が代わりに受け取る場合も、この番号札を渡せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長椅子で待つと答え同行者による番号札での受け取り可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait on the bench. If someone with me collects it on my behalf, can they just hand you this numbered ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait on the bench, and ask whether your companion can collect the book using the numbered ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回は番号札でお渡しできますが、受け取る前に表紙もご確認ください。十二番、仕上がりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this collection, we can hand it over in exchange for the numbered ticket, but please check the cover before taking it. Number twelve, it's ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これですね。私の帳面は紺の表紙で、角に小さな桜の模様があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の御朱印帳が紺の表紙に小さな桜模様だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one, right? My book has a navy cover with a small cherry blossom design in the corner.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your goshuin stamp book has a navy cover with a small cherry blossom design. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらの表紙に桜の模様があります。中の頁もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this cover has a cherry blossom design. Please also check the page inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表紙もお願いした頁も合っています。番号札はここに返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表紙と依頼した頁の一致を確認し番号札を返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both the cover and the page I requested are correct. I'll return the numbered ticket here.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the cover and requested page are correct, and return the numbered ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお返しいただきました。大切にお持ちください。ご参拝ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received it, thank you. Please take good care of your book. Thank you for your visit to worship. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座のお申込みについてのご相談ですね。ご利用の目的をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss applying for an account, correct? Please tell me what you will use it for.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与を受け取るためです。会社からこの銀行の口座を用意するよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受取用で勤務先からこの銀行の口座を求められたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: To receive my salary. My company told me to open an account at this bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the account is for receiving your salary and that your employer requested an account at this bank. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支店の指定もありますか。会社から受け取った案内があれば確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did they specify a branch, too? If you have any instructions from your company, let's check them.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙には港支店とありますが、私が書いた申込書はここの支店名です。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社案内の港支店と自分の申込書の支店名が異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: This paper says Minato Branch, but the application I filled in has this branch's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the Minato Branch named in the company instructions differs from the branch on your application. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確かに異なります。会社が港支店を必須としているか、まずご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: They are indeed different. Could you first check whether your company requires the Minato Branch specifically?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者に電話しますので、今の申込みは進めずに待っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社へ電話確認する間は申込みを進めないよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll call the person in charge. Could you hold off on processing this application while I do that?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the application to be put on hold while you phone your company to confirm. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、手続きは止めておきます。会社への確認ができたら結果を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll pause the procedure. Please let me know the result once you've checked with your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認できました。会社は港支店を指定していました。今日は必要な書類だけ教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社が港支店を指定していた結果を伝え今日は必要書類の案内だけ求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've confirmed it. The company did specify the Minato Branch. Today, please just tell me which documents I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that your company specified the Minato Branch, and ask only for information on the required documents today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 港支店の担当に申込み方法と書類を確認してからご案内します。開設の可否や時期は審査前にはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the application procedure and documents with the Minato Branch staff before advising you. Before screening, I can't promise whether an account can be opened or when.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、確認できた内容をメモでもらえますか。開設前に口座番号を会社へ伝えるのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認結果のメモを頼み開設前の会社への口座番号報告を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Could you give me a note of what you confirm, then? I'll wait before giving my company an account number until the account has been opened.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a written note of the confirmed information, and say that you will wait to report the account number to your company until the account is opened. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認結果をメモにしてお渡しします。ご案内に沿って港支店へご相談ください。本日はありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-ONOMICHI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you a note of what we've confirmed. Please consult the Minato Branch following these instructions. Thank you for coming today. Take care.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この二箱を出荷台へ運びます。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: We're going to take these two boxes to the shipping platform.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: どちらも魚が入っていますね。氷が少なく見えますが、このまま運んでいいですか。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱の氷量を見て運搬可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: They both contain fish, don't they? There doesn't seem to be much ice. Is it all right to move them as they are?
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the amount of ice in the boxes and ask whether they can be moved. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの箱は担当が追加を予定しています。今はもう一箱だけ運んでください。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge plans to add ice to this box. For now, please move only the other one.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 追加する箱は残します。ふたを閉じてから運ぶのですか。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加対象を残しふた閉鎖の手順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll leave the box that needs more ice here. Should I close the lid before moving it?
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the box awaiting more ice, and confirm the procedure for closing the lid. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この留め具を確認してください。持ち手に指を深く入れないように持ちます。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please check this fastener. Hold it without putting your fingers too far into the handles.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち方を見せてください。箱が重いので、台車を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち方の実演と台車使用を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please show me how to hold it. The box is heavy, so I'd like to use a cart.
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a demonstration of how to hold the box and permission to use a cart. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの台車を使います。一人で持ち上げず、私と一緒に載せましょう。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll use this cart. Don't lift it alone; let's put it on together.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一緒にお願いします。出荷台の下が濡れていますが、台車はどこで止めますか。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共同積載を頼み濡れた床の停止位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me. The floor under the shipping platform is wet. Where should I stop the cart?
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to load it together, and ask where to stop because the floor is wet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 濡れた場所を避け、手前の線で止めてください。そこから先は受け取り担当に渡します。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Avoid the wet area and stop at the line before it. From there, hand it over to the receiving staff.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ふたを確認して一緒に載せ、手前の線まで運びます。残った箱の氷は担当に任せます。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一箱の運搬範囲と氷追加の担当を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the lid, load it with you, and take it as far as the line before the wet area. I'll leave adding ice to the remaining box to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm how far to transport the one box and who is responsible for adding ice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、出荷台までお願いします。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-HYG-AKASHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take it to the shipping platform. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどんな魚をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of fish are you looking for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕食に焼く魚を二尾欲しいです。グリルが小さいので、開いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小型グリル用の魚二尾の開きを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like two fish to grill for dinner. My grill is small, so could you split them open?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for two fish to be split open for a small grill. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: できます。この魚なら開くと平らになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, we can. This fish lies flat when it's split open.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それを二尾お願いします。頭も付いたままですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 魚を選び頭の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take two of those, please. Will the heads still be attached?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the fish and ask whether the heads will be left on. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 頭は取ることもできます。グリルに入りやすくするなら、取っておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can remove the heads, too. Shall we do that so they fit into the grill more easily?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 頭は取ってください。一尾ずつ包んでもらえると、片方を明日に回せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 頭取りと翌日用に一尾ずつの包装を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please remove the heads. If you wrap each fish separately, I can save one for tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request removal of the heads and separate wrapping for each fish so that one can be kept for tomorrow. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別々に包めます。生のまま置くなら早めに冷やし、保存の目安は包装に記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can wrap them separately. If you're keeping them raw, chill them promptly. I'll write storage guidance on the wrapping.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家までは三十分です。保冷用の氷を一緒に入れてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅までの時間を述べ氷を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's thirty minutes to my home. Could you include some ice to keep them cool?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say how long it takes to get home, and ask for ice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、袋の外側へ氷を入れます。帰宅したらすぐ冷蔵庫へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I'll put ice around the outside of the bag. Please put the fish in the refrigerator as soon as you get home.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。二尾とも開いて頭を取り、一尾ずつ包んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二尾の下処理と個別包装を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. Split both fish open, remove the heads, and wrap them individually.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the preparation of both fish and the separate wrapping. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お席で召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be eating here at a table?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。明石焼きは、たこ焼きと同じようにソースを付ける物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明石焼きの食べ方をたこ焼きと比べて聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Do you put sauce on akashiyaki in the same way as takoyaki?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to eat akashiyaki by comparing it with takoyaki. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは温かいだしをお出しします。塩もお使いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, we serve it with warm dashi broth. You can also use salt.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人前ください。最初はだしに付けず、塩で食べてみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人前と最初の塩味を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: One serving, please. First, I'd like to try it with salt, without dipping it in the broth.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Order one serving and say you would like to try it with salt first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 塩は卓上にあります。だしは別の器でお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The salt is on the table. I'll bring the broth in a separate bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 器ごと熱いですか。すぐに口に入れると熱そうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: だし器と料理の熱さを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is the bowl hot as well? It looks like it would be hot if I put it straight into my mouth.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the broth bowl and the food are hot. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 熱いので、少し冷ましてからお召し上がりください。中にも熱が残ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's hot, so please let it cool a little before eating. It stays hot inside, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つ割って冷まします。だしは食べるたびに付けるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 割って冷ますと述べだしの付け方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll break one open and let it cool. Do I dip each piece in the broth as I eat it?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will break one open to cool it, and ask how to dip it in the broth. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お好みで少しずつ付けてください。全部を器に入れる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, dip a little at a time, as you prefer. There's no need to put all of them in the bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。塩で一つ、次は少し冷ましてだしで食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 塩とだしで順番に味わうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see. I'll have one with salt, then let the next one cool a little and try it with the broth.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will try salt first and then the broth. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお楽しみください。ごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your meal. Take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗船についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about boarding the boat?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。船に酔いやすいので、今日の揺れの見込みを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 船酔いの不安から揺れの見込みを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I get seasick easily, so I'd like to know how much rocking is expected today.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how much rocking is expected because you are worried about seasickness. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の運航案内では風があります。ただ、酔うかどうかは人によって異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current service information indicates windy conditions. However, whether someone gets seasick varies from person to person.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 揺れないとは言えないのですね。客室で途中から席を変えてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不確実性を理解し船内の席移動を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So you can't say there won't be any rocking. Can I change seats in the cabin during the trip?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the uncertainty and ask about changing seats on board. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この便は自由席です。移動する時は船内の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This sailing has unreserved seating. Please follow the on-board instructions when moving around.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自由席なら助かります。外のデッキへ出られる時間は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自由席を確認しデッキ利用時間を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Unreserved seating would help. Are there set times when passengers can go out onto the deck?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the unreserved seating and ask about deck access times. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 航行中の利用は船内係員にご確認ください。天候によって閉じる場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the crew about using it while the boat is underway. It may be closed depending on the weather.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は乗らず、次の予定を考えます。まだ券を買っていないので、そのまま帰れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗船を見送り券未購入の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see. I'll skip the boat today and think about another plan. Since I haven't bought a ticket yet, I can just leave, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to board and confirm what to do since you have not bought a ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、購入前ですので、お手続きはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Since you haven't purchased one, there's no procedure to complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。風の様子も考えて、別の日に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 天候を考え別日に再訪すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll take the wind conditions into account and come back another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will consider the weather and return another day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: またのご利用をお待ちしています。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to welcoming you another time. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時計の展示をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to see the clock exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この大きな時計が動くところを見たいです。今は止まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大型時計の運転状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to see this large clock working. Is it stopped at the moment?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the large clock is running. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示中は止めています。実演は別の小さな時計で行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We keep it stopped while it is on display. We use a different, smaller clock for the demonstration.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きな時計は動かさないのですね。小さな時計の実演は何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実演対象の違いを理解し開始時刻を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So you don't run the large clock. What time is the demonstration with the small clock?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand a different clock is demonstrated, and ask when it starts. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次は十四時です。十五分ほどの説明になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The next one is at two p.m. The explanation takes about fifteen minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 参加したいです。途中で歯車に触ることはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実演参加を希望し部品への接触を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to attend. Can I touch the gears during the demonstration?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you would like to attend the demonstration and ask whether you can touch the parts. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実演中は触れません。触れる模型は、隣の台にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can't touch them during the demonstration. There's a model you can touch on the stand next to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、先に模型を見ます。模型を回す向きは決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 触れる模型を選び回転方向を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll look at the model first. Is there a particular direction I should turn it?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the hands-on model and ask which direction to turn it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 矢印の向きに、ゆっくり回してください。止まったら無理に回さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please turn it slowly in the direction of the arrow. If it stops, don't force it to turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 矢印を見て試します。十四時になったら実演の前へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 模型の扱いと実演へ戻る時刻を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the arrow and give it a try. I'll come back to the demonstration area at two p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe how you will handle the model and what time you will return for the demonstration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AKASHI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy it. I'll leave you to it.
